tasks.title: Discovery finds every supported client on Windows, macOS and Linux

criteria.statement: T1-c01: src/cli/discover.mjs exists and a faked HKCU Uninstall entry DisplayName 'Grok Bot' with a blank InstallLocation and a DisplayIcon under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Grok Bot gives grok-bot found with install_path that folder
T1-c02: a faked HKLM WOW6432Node entry 'Microsoft Copilot' is found and reported with automation none

T1-c03: a %LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages\Claude_pzs8sxrjxfjjc folder alone makes claude-desktop found with evidence msix (the family suffix is an example fixture, not laptop evidence; the laptop showed only 'Appx: Claude 4.23118.0.0')
T1-c04: on darwin, /Applications/ChatGPT.app or ~/Applications/ChatGPT.app makes chatgpt-desktop found; no invented desktop bundle path is used
T1-c05: on linux, a .desktop file or a PATH entry named after the app makes it found; a PATH entry that is a directory does not
T1-c06: every id of clientDefs and unsupportedDefs, on every platform, has a probe, and each fixture home that the old detect() found is still found

T1-c07: spies cover spawn, spawnSync, execFile, execFileSync, fork and exec; only absolute system reg.exe query with shell:false once per configured hive is allowed on Windows, including timeout cases; no process runs on other platforms

T1-c08: spies cover readFile, readFileSync, fs.promises.readFile, open, openSync, fs.promises.open, createReadStream and readSync; no client data content is read, including through realpath, symlinks, imported aliases and readSync descriptors; escaping or data-targeting links are rejected
T1-c09: a registry query that times out leaves discovery working from folders and PATH and reports the timeout in --json
T1-c10: memev discover --json prints the documented shape and exits 0 on an empty home
T1-c11: no mutant of src/cli/discover.mjs survives this task's tests (QL-1.02)
Changes stay in scope
